data.long_meaning: Deevaanshi is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘deeva’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘anshi’ meaning ‘sense’ or ‘feel’. The name signifies a divine sense or feeling, a goddess who is deeply connected to the divine. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
